sources.title: Koha Manual — Circulation
sources.locator: Check out lines 22–100; automatic check-in lines 495–499; Claim returned lines 614–631; bundle add/circulation/checkin/missing sections lines 697–785
sources.observed_operation: Checkout scans item barcode; optional keyword fallback. Automatic checkin requires item-type configuration and automatic_checkin.pl cron. Bundle return scans expected child barcodes; missing children are marked lost and tied to a claim. Claim-return entry accepts note and fee decision.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Item barcode fallback is a preference; automatic checkin is optional. Bundle verification can be skipped. Missing-as-lost is configurable. Claim returned is a patron report about a loan, not a general correction ledger.
sources.applicability: Strong kit/circulation fit; configure no automatic return and test atomic damage hold and durable correction history.

critic_verification.critic_status: independently reopened
critic_verification.critic_locator: https://koha-community.org/manual/latest/en/html/circulation.html; checkout/check-in, optional automatic_checkin.pl, bundle records and scanned return verification (§§ 495–499, 667–712, 757–805), offline logs and ordered multi-computer replay (§§ 2160–2268).
critic_verification.critic_observation: Confirmed that Koha bundles use existing barcode item records; bundled child items are not individually loanable; return verification can be skipped; missing contents are marked lost/claimed; automatic check-in is optional; offline state may be stale and multi-computer logs must be processed in transaction order.

reviser_verification.version_or_commit: Koha Manual edition 20261011 (edition shown on opened page)
reviser_verification.locator: Circulating bundles §§ 664–762, especially bundle creation §§ 697–712, individual-checkout prompt §§ 743–749, and return verification §§ 757–762.
reviser_verification.access_utc: 2026-10-12T01:25:03Z–2026-10-12T01:25:22Z; exact per-request fetch timestamp was not exposed
reviser_verification.observed_operation: Bundle children are added from existing item records using their barcodes and are marked not-for-loan. The manual says individual checkout is not ordinarily allowed but the displayed staff prompt offers a checkout-anyway choice. Return prompts for barcode scans; verification may be skipped. Neighboring missing-item instructions describe the configured lost-item action.
reviser_verification.governing_condition_default_exception: The not-for-loan status is a circulation control with a staff override prompt; it is not an absolute technical prohibition. Bundle verification also has an explicit skip path; missing-item behavior is configurable.
reviser_verification.applicability: Confirms a per-child item-record/barcode burden for native bundles while narrowing the claim about individual checkout. Test override permissions and verification behavior with actual kits.

sources.locator: Item records/barcodes; 952$3 Materials specified; barcode generator section around lines 2273–2317

sources.title: Koha Manual — Circulation preferences
sources.locator: StoreLastBorrower lines 403–427; UpdateNotForLoanStatusOnCheckin lines 496–514; HidePersonalPatronDetail lines 310–325; RenewalSendNotice lines 1357–1375
sources.observed_operation: StoreLastBorrower default is 0, but manual says last three borrowers still appear unless checkouts anonymized. Check-in mapping only maps an existing not-for-loan status to another configured value.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Last-borrower history may persist even when preference is zero. Mapping applies only to matching current status/item type; it does not map a free-standing damaged flag. Overrides may permit checkout unless denied.
sources.applicability: Privacy and maintenance-hold decisions require explicit configuration and a return-path test.

critic_verification.critic_status: independently reopened
critic_verification.critic_observation: Confirmed StoreLastBorrower default 0, with a manual note that last three borrowers remain visible unless checkouts are anonymized; AllowNotForLoanOverride defaults to Allow.

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Anonymization requires configured AnonymousPatron and a chosen date threshold; delete is materially different and permanent.
sources.applicability: Shows a retention mechanism, not a retention policy; owner must define whether five-year history includes personal identities.

sources.title: Koha Manual — offline circulation
sources.locator: Offline circulation section around lines 2160–2323; multi-computer replay lines 2244–2283
sources.observed_operation: Manual describes Firefox add-on and Windows utility; offline computer stores transaction log; logs from multiple computers must be uploaded/grouped and applied in correct order.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Offline mode uses stale borrower/item state and may permit action the online system would block; ordered replay is required. Current manual does not establish multi-master conflict-free live writes.
sources.applicability: Internet loss with LAN intact is different from LAN/server loss. Avoid relying on laptop offline mode for immediate shared availability.

critic_verification.critic_status: independently reopened
critic_verification.critic_observation: Confirmed local offline transaction logs, stale holds/account restrictions, all-machine log collection and checkout-before-check-in ordering example.

The caller/order was not independently traced; do not infer a product defect from the predicate alone.

reviser_verification.version_or_commit: Snipe-IT v8.8.0 tag; carried release commit 2c466fa

sources.title: SQLite Write-Ahead Logging
sources.locator: WAL limitations, lines/paragraphs on network filesystems and one writer
sources.observed_operation: WAL shared-memory index requires processes on same host; WAL does not work over a network filesystem; one writer at a time.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: WAL-specific constraints; SQLite has other modes, but a shared file DB is still not the preferred two-host authority.
sources.applicability: Reject a naive shared SQLite file as the concurrent laptop deployment design.

critic_verification.critic_status: independently reopened
critic_verification.critic_observation: Confirmed WAL index access relies on a shared mapped file in the database directory and the documented no-shared-memory mode requires a single process; the draft scopes this as a constraint on shared/network use.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 17 Explicit Locking
sources.locator: §13.3 row-level lock modes, FOR UPDATE
sources.observed_operation: FOR UPDATE locks selected rows against conflicting writes/locks until transaction ends.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Application must use one transaction with revalidation/unique constraints and handle deadlocks; database row locks alone do not define product workflow.
sources.applicability: Basis for a local authoritative service/custom architecture candidate.

critic_verification.critic_status: independently reopened
critic_verification.critic_observation: Confirmed FOR UPDATE blocks conflicting writes and locks on the same row until transaction end.

sources.title: Koha Manual — damaged and not-for-loan statuses
sources.locator: Damaged status lines 3034–3078; not-for-loan status lines 3142–3200; AllowNotForLoanOverride preference lines 683–696 in circulationpreferences.html
sources.observed_operation: Damaged status makes search results unavailable but does not stop checkout/check-in. Not-for-loan status blocks checkout unless staff override is permitted; override default is Allow. Positive values prevent checkout and holds; configured check-in mapping only updates existing not-for-loan state.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: To make a hard hold, configure a not-for-loan status and disallow overrides; damaged flag by itself is not a hold. The status mapping is not a damage-to-hold workflow, so a status transition may need explicit staff action and must be race-tested.
sources.applicability: Critical fit limitation for the damaged-return requirement; do not accept Koha without a tested one-step hold workflow.

critic_verification.critic_status: independently reopened
critic_verification.critic_observation: Confirmed damaged flag does not block checkout/check-in, the not-for-loan override default is Allow, and check-in mapping applies to a matching existing not-for-loan value.
